title: Read the run result
summary: A run log shows which jobs and steps completed. A green result means the configured commands passed, not that every product requirement was checked.
introduction: A run log shows which jobs and steps completed. A green result means the configured commands passed, not that every product requirement was checked. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Read the run result

blocks.text: The result has a clear scope. Add useful checks intentionally rather than trusting a badge alone.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never print real secrets just to diagnose a workflow.
